text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...I thought it was unusual to hear from 
you. I see, so you've fallen from grace."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
And? Did you come here to cling to me? 
Just so you can keep hanging on to the 
lowest seat at the next clan meeting—...?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu, speaking to me at a time like 
this. Now that you've entered the tiger's 
den, you're prepared for the consequences, 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Then prove it to me. Your strength. The 
fangs and power to survive in that world. 
...Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu, fufufu! Straining like that, my 
goodness... That's enough. You don't need 
to prove your strength here."
